response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, experienced full-stack engineer with 15+ years across web, mobile, embedded, and infrastructure, and some entrepreneurial spirit as founder of an open-source project. However, the role calls for a Director-level Principal Engineer with recognized AI expertise, demonstrated AI products/platforms, and experience advising strategic customers on cloud/AI adoption — none of which is substantiated here. His AI exposure is limited to a few months of MCP/agent tooling work, and his career trajectory (Senior/Staff titles) does not reflect the strategic, thought-leadership scope this role demands.
strengths: Broad, deep technical breadth across languages, platforms, and infrastructure (web, mobile, embedded, DevOps)
Entrepreneurial track record as founder/maintainer of an open-source Geo-Data platform (GISCollective) used in production
Demonstrated thought-leadership via conference talks, workshops, and community teaching
concerns: No advanced degree or specialized credentials in AI/ML; minimal demonstrated AI product/platform experience
Career level (Senior/Staff Engineer) doesn't match the Director-level strategic scope of this Principal Engineer role
No evident experience advising external strategic customers/partners on cloud or AI adoption strategy

key_factors.factor: Lack of recognized AI expertise or AI-built products
Seniority/title mismatch vs. Director-level strategic IC role
Broad technical versatility and entrepreneurial background
